newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First thwarted over super surtax debate.
newsitem.headline: NZ First thwarted over super surtax debate.

text.p: New Zealand First's attempt to prolong debate on the raising of the superannuation surtax threshold was blocked by parliament's business committee on Tuesday.
The committee, dominated by National and Labour, restricted the available debating time for the bill to 45 minutes.
This means the bill, increasing the surcharge thresholds with effect from April 1, 1997, will pass through its final stages and become law today.
New Zealand First leader Winston Peters accused the two big parties of "holding hands" to arrange the deal. His party argues the surtax should be scrapped altogether.
